name: Unstoppable Shipping to Delivery for WooCommerce
author: Unstoppable Solutions

sections.description:
Unstoppable Shipping to Delivery for WooCommerce is a lightweight plugin that automatically replaces all instances of “Shipping” with “Delivery” throughout your WooCommerce store’s frontend.

Perfect for stores that prefer the term “Delivery” over “Shipping” – simply activate the plugin and you’re done!

Features

  • Zero Configuration – Just activate and it works
  • Case Preservation – Maintains original capitalization (Shipping → Delivery, SHIPPING → DELIVERY, shipping → delivery)
  • Comprehensive Coverage – Works across all WooCommerce frontend areas including:
    • Cart and checkout pages
    • Order confirmation emails
    • My Account pages
    • Product pages
    • Order status labels
    • REST API responses
    • WooCommerce Blocks
  • Performance Optimized – Only runs on frontend, skips admin for speed
  • Compatible with Orderable – Also works with Orderable plugin text
  • HPOS Compatible – Fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage

Why Use This Plugin?

Many businesses prefer the term “Delivery” as it better represents their service model. Whether you run a local delivery service, restaurant, or simply prefer the terminology, this plugin makes the change effortless.

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or higher
  • WooCommerce 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
sections.installation:
1. Upload the unstoppable-shipping-to-delivery folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. That’s it! No configuration needed

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress admin
  3. Click “Upload Plugin” and select the zip file
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require any configuration?

No! Simply activate the plugin and all instances of “Shipping” will automatically be replaced with “Delivery” on your store’s frontend.

Will this affect my admin area?

No. The plugin only modifies text on the frontend of your store. Your WordPress admin and WooCommerce settings will continue to show “Shipping” as normal.

Does this work with WooCommerce Blocks?

Yes! The plugin is fully compatible with both classic WooCommerce shortcodes and the newer block-based cart and checkout.

Will this break my translations?

No. The plugin works with WooCommerce’s translation system and will properly replace text regardless of your site’s language.

Is this compatible with HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage)?

Yes! The plugin declares full compatibility with WooCommerce’s High-Performance Order Storage feature.

Does this work with Orderable plugin?

Yes! The plugin also replaces “Shipping” with “Delivery” in Orderable, Orderable Pro, and Orderable Lite plugins.

Can I customize which words get replaced?

Currently, the plugin specifically replaces “Shipping” with “Delivery”. For custom replacements, consider using a dedicated string replacement plugin.

Will this slow down my site?

No. The plugin is highly optimized and uses efficient string matching. It only processes text from specific WooCommerce text domains and skips admin pages entirely.
